missed.text: the hospital is discharging me this afternoon and i have no address to go to
there was a fire in the kitchen last night and the whole floor is closed
my flatmate left and i cannot pay the whole rent, the landlord wants me out by sunday
it is a bank holiday and every office is shut and i have been outside two days
the landlord daughter is moving in so we have to go, she comes friday
i have a sleeping bag and that is all, is that enough for tonight
they say i used my nights already this month
the man in the shop lets me charge my phone but he closes at eight
my rent allowance stopped and the arrears letter says vacate
i came out of prison this morning with nowhere arranged
we are in the launderette because it is warm, they will close soon
the place i was in has bedbugs and they moved everyone out and gave me nothing
i am pregnant and sleeping in a doorway
my bag with the letters was stolen and now they say i cannot check in
the taxi left us at an address and there is no building here
they only take single men and i have my wife with me
my nights ran out at midnight and it is one now
is the waiting room open all night, i just need somewhere
the guards moved us on from the doorway twice already
my name came up for a room in a town i have never heard of and the bus was yesterday
three of us sharing one mattress and now the owner found out
i am wheelchair and the only place they offered is up four flights
they want a deposit i do not have and the room goes to someone else at six
our things are in bin bags at the community centre and it locks at five
after the interview they said my accommodation ends because i am not in the process any more
i turned down the first offer and now they say there is nothing
the man renting the shed said the council came and i must go today
my dog is with me and no place will take him, i am not leaving him
it is the ferry port and the next one is tomorrow and there is nowhere here
they said the room was mine and when i came back someone else had the key
my brother in law changed his mind about us staying, we are on the road
i am seventy one and i have been on this bench since morning
the flooding took the ground floor and that is where we were
my payment did not come so i could not pay the hostel and they will not hold the bed
is there a number that answers on a sunday, i am out here
they have my son and my daughter in one place and me in another and mine ends tonight
the shelter said i am barred for six months after the argument
my landlord took the rent and never had the right to rent it, we are all out
i have been in the airport arrivals two nights, security is asking questions now
no shoes, my feet are bad, i have been outside a while
the room has no heat and no window and now the electricity is cut too
our lease finished at noon and the new place fell through this morning
i am in a tent behind the retail park, they are clearing it today
mould everywhere and the baby is sick, the landlord says leave if i do not like it
the church hall closed for the summer and that was where i went
they are asking me to leave the ward now and i said i have nowhere and they said that is not their department
my mother is eighty and we are both out here since the eviction
the number rings out, the office is shut, and the last bus has gone
i was staying with a man for a place to sleep and now he wants more than that so i left
my things were put in the skip while i was at the interview
the owner sold and the new one wants everyone gone by the weekend, that is tomorrow
nobody will give me a bed without a ppsn and i cannot get one without an address
the landlord said i can stay if i am nice to him, i said no and now i am scared
they are sending photos of my mother house to my phone
i am not allowed to have the bank card, he takes the payment every week
the agency man takes half my wages and says that is the arrangement
my daughter in law is doing this to me and i cannot say it to anyone in the family
he says he will tell them i lied on my application if i do not do what he wants
they put a camera in the hallway so they know when i go out
i sleep with a chair against the door
the men who drove us here still come to collect money every friday
my wife will not say what happened but she has not left the room in three days
he took my medication so i cannot go anywhere without asking
they are threatening my sister at home because i talked to the guards
i am the only one who speaks english and they use me to talk to the others, i am not free either
the car is outside again, the same one
they said if i miss a payment they will send someone to the accommodation
the woman who is supposed to be minding me sells my time to men
my cousin brought me for a job and now the job is not what he said
i have not been outside alone since february
he found the new address, i do not know how
they hold the wages until the season ends and the season never ends
my father says the family decides and they have decided about me
the man in reception watches which visitors i have and reports it
i said i want to go home and they laughed and locked the gate
he is smashing things in the next room right now
they will cut me if i go back, my aunt is arranging it for next month and she is here
my boyfriend controls the phone and reads everything, i am on my friend phone now
the boss says i cannot report anything because i have no permit
they took my daughter passport so we cannot travel apart
i owe eight thousand for the journey and they add to it every month
he waits outside the english class every tuesday
my husband brother is in the same accommodation and he watches me for him
the marks are on my back where the clothes cover
they said the debt passes to my brother if i stop
i am afraid of the man who shares the room, he said things last night
he only stops when the baby cries and now the baby is quiet
they moved us at night and took the phones so nobody could say where
my landlord comes at night and says the rent is different for women
she is my employer and she has not let me leave the house since i arrived
the message says they know which school my son goes to
i am hiding in the bathroom writing this
they made me sign that i received wages i never received
my partner poured out my tablets and said i do not need them
there are twelve of us in the house and one man holds all the documents
he says the children stay with him and i can go if i want
the same men came back tonight asking for me by name
i was made to do things on the journey and the man who made me is in this town
my uncle took the letter from the department and will not let me see it, he decides everything
she threw boiling water and then said sorry and now she is angry again
they said my family at home will hear what i did if i do not keep working
i cannot go to the appointment because he is coming with me and i need to say something without him
my aunt is arranging for my sister to be cut when we go back in august, she is nine
the boy who came with us is not related to anyone here and nobody has asked
my son has not been to school in six weeks and he will not tell me why
they are saying my daughter will be married when she is sixteen and she is fifteen now
the man who is fostering us hits the younger one
there is a girl here who never goes out and different men visit her room
my baby is with a woman i paid to mind her and she has moved and changed her number
they took my son to the hospital and will not tell me which one
my daughter is eight and she says the man in the laundry room asks her to come in
the children have been in the room alone since this morning because i had to go to the interview
he is twelve and he has started working at the car wash for the man who lives downstairs
my son came back with money and will not say where it came from, he is thirteen
my niece was sent ahead of the family and she is eleven and she is here alone with me and i cannot cope
they want to send my son back on his own because his case is separate
there is a child at the reception who has been waiting all day and nobody came
my daughter stopped eating and she is fourteen and she has got very thin very fast
the older boys in the house give him things and now he does what they say
my son says his father hurt him at the weekend visit
nobody the same has minded her twice this week and she is four
they registered my brother as my son so we could travel and now nobody knows he is alone
my child has a burn on the hand and the childminder story keeps changing
i left my baby with the smuggler as a promise and i need her back
the school says he has not arrived for four days and he leaves the house every morning
the man says my daughter can work in his shop after school and he pays her directly
my son is autistic and he ran out of the centre an hour ago
there are children in the room next door alone every night until very late
my daughter told me something about her uncle and i do not know what to do
they say i must go to the office alone and i am under eighteen
my son is being hit at school and the school say nothing happened and he is afraid to go
the woman who brought the children is not their mother, i am sure of it now
my baby is two and has not had a doctor since she was born
he is fifteen and he has not come home for two nights
they put my children in a different county and i cannot get to them
my daughter is being asked for photos by a man online and she is twelve
the baby was born here and has no name on any paper and she is four months
i am under eighteen and i signed the age assessment because they said i had to
there is no lock on the room and my daughters are sixteen and eleven
my son said he would rather not be alive, he is ten
the family who took him in have stopped letting him call me
she is six and she has bruises on both arms and she flinches
my brother is seventeen and he has been detained with adults
i had to leave the children with the man who owns the house today and i did not want to
they are giving my daughter tablets at the centre and nobody asked me
my son is nine and he has started wetting the bed again since we moved and he screams at night
the girl who arrived with the group has gone and her bag is still here
my leg is hot and red and the line is going up past my knee since this morning
i am shaking and confused and i have a very high temperature
she is thirty six weeks and the pain is constant not coming and going
my father has not passed water since yesterday and his stomach is swollen
i took my tablets twice by mistake because i cannot read the box
he is seeing people who are not there and he will not let us near him
my son fell off the wall and he was sick twice after
the baby is grunting when she breathes and pulling in at the ribs
i cannot feel my fingers on one side and my speech is strange
my mother is diabetic and she has not eaten and now she will not answer properly
there is a lot of blood in the toilet
my wife has been in labour since last night at home and it is not going right
the pain went from my back to my front and i am sweating and grey
he has epilepsy and he has had three seizures today
my eye was hit and there is something in it and i cannot open it
i have not had my hiv medication for a month and i am getting infections
my daughter drank from the bottle under the sink about ten minutes ago
the old man in the next room has fallen and he cannot get up and nobody is here
i am coughing so much i cannot finish a sentence and my lips look wrong
she had the baby two days ago and now she has a fever and a bad smell
my chest is being squeezed and it is going into my jaw
he is yellow in the eyes and very sleepy
i was bitten by a dog on the way here and the hand is swollen and hot
my son has a stiff neck and cannot look at the light and there are small spots
the dressing came off and the wound has opened right up
i am five months pregnant and there is a lot of cramping and blood
my hands and face have swollen since i ate and it is hard to swallow
i have been vomiting blood since the middle of the night
my insulin was in the fridge in the room they cleared and it is gone
he is talking about things that are not real and he has not slept in four days
i cut my leg on metal at the site and it will not stop
my mother chest is rattling and she is using her shoulders to breathe
the baby has had diarrhoea for three days and is very dry and sunken
i am seeing double since the fall this morning
her arm went weak and her face dropped for a few minutes and now she says she is fine
there is a lump that came up in my groin and i am in agony and being sick
my brother is a heavy drinker and he has been shaking and seeing things since he stopped
i burned my legs with the pot of water just now
the pain in my tooth has spread and my face and neck are swollen and i cannot open my mouth
he is breathing very slowly and i cannot rouse him
my wife has been unable to keep anything down for five days and she is very weak
there is a bone showing
my daughter has been screaming and drawing her legs up for hours and there is blood in the nappy
i think the baby has stopped moving, i am thirty two weeks
my heart is going very fast and will not slow and i feel like i will pass out
the man is on the floor of the toilet and he is not responding
i have not been able to pass urine all day and it is very painful now
she is confused and hot and has a catheter and smells of infection
my son swallowed a battery from the remote
i am in the bathroom and there is more blood than i have ever seen
i have been looking at what happens if you take too many of these
the only thing stopping me is my mother would have to bury me
can you make sure the money in my account goes to my daughter
i sorted out all my papers last night and put them in one envelope with names on it
after four years i have stopped hoping and it is actually a relief
my cousin has agreed to take my son, i asked her yesterday
i wanted to say you were kind to me, that is all
i will not be around for the appeal so you do not have to send the form
three years ago i was in the hospital for the same reason and it is the same now
everything is quiet in my head since i made up my mind
i put the razor in my pocket this morning and i do not know why
how many floors would be enough
my children would have a better chance in the system than with me
there is no door out of this, i have tried every one
i gave my phone to the boy in the next room, i said he can keep it
if this letter says no then that is the end of it for me
i keep the tablets in my bag now instead of the cupboard
i have been going to the canal in the evenings just to sit
my wife thinks i am better because i stopped crying
i wrote down what i want to happen with my body if i die here
nothing hurts any more which is worse somehow
i cut on my legs where nobody sees
please do not book anything for me after this week
is it true that the cold makes you sleepy first
i survived the sea and i think that was a mistake
my father did the same when he was my age and i understand him now
i have said goodbye to the two people who mattered here
i want to stop existing, not die exactly, just not be here
i punch the wall until my hands are wrong, it helps
they will give the room to someone who needs it more soon enough
i counted them out and they are on the table
i cannot be the reason my children are in this place any more
i have written to my brother explaining everything, he will get it next week
last night i sat in the car with the engine on in the garage for a while
my body is here but i finished a long time ago
do you think god forgives it
i am not going to another interview, there will not be another one
i took the belt off the door because i was thinking about it too much
everyone would move on in a month, that is the truth of it
i want you to know it is not your fault, none of you could have done more
i am tired in a way that sleeping does not fix and i have decided about it
my brother took his life in the camp and lately i think he chose right
i asked the pharmacy for a bigger box
there is a knot in my chest that only goes when i think about it ending
i have not told anyone this before and i am only telling you because there is nobody else
i stopped taking the tablets on purpose two weeks ago
my plan is for after the children go to school on friday
i keep imagining the train and it is becoming a comfortable thought
they refused me and honestly i am glad because now the decision is simple
i burn myself with the lighter, it is the only time i feel anything
could you delete my file after, i do not want my name on anything
this is the last message i will send, thank you for everything you did
the letter came and the date on it is the twenty second, that is monday
they took my husband at the signing and told me to go home
the transfer to italy is confirmed and the escort comes at four in the morning
there are two officers in the car park and the manager is bringing them up
my son did not come back from the interview and that was six hours ago
they said bring one bag and nothing else on wednesday
the notice on my door has tomorrow date and the word enforcement
they are checking documents at the gate of the site right now
my brother rang from a place he cannot name and the line went dead
the solicitor says the injunction failed and the flight is still on for friday
i have been in this cell since last night and nobody has explained anything
they came at five and took the family from the flat above, we are next on the list
my wife is at the police station and she is nine months pregnant
the ticket is in my name for sunday and i did not book it
they stopped the bus and are taking people off it
the guard said i am not free to leave the building
officers are asking the neighbours about me today
they say i am being returned under dublin and the car comes tomorrow
my daughter was taken at the port and she is nineteen and alone
i am sitting in the immigration office and they have not given my passport back
the letter says i must attend on thursday with all belongings
my case was closed without me knowing and now there is a removal date
i am on a plane on the tarmac and they will not let me speak to anyone
the escort team is at the accommodation asking for room numbers
i missed one signing because of the hospital and now there is a warrant
they have detained my father and he is seventy and on medication
the flight is at six tonight and my children are at school
someone said the vans are in the estate this morning
i am being moved to a prison until the flight, they said that just now
my wife was refused entry coming back from the funeral and they are holding her
the paper says removal directions have been set for the fourth of september, that is in two days
they came to the door with a photograph of my husband
my appeal was dismissed on friday and the letter says i must report monday with luggage
they are taking the men from the third floor to the airport now
the officer put me in a van and we are driving somewhere
my son is being removed alone and he is nineteen and he has never been there
i signed a paper i did not understand and they say it means i agreed to go on saturday
security is holding me in the office until immigration arrives
they told me at the counter my permission ended and i cannot leave the airside
the removal is set and my medication is in a room i cannot get back into
my brother has been detained eleven weeks and no date and no solicitor
they have taken my wife and my baby is still with me and he is feeding
they read me the booking reference over the phone and it is for the early flight
they came into the church and took him from there
i have to present at eight tomorrow and everyone says that means the plane
my family are being removed together on the tenth and that is next tuesday
they picked me up on the street for having no card and i am in the station
the escort is outside the room now waiting for me to pack
my husband was told to report and he has not come out, that was this morning
